quick_skim.title: Grid-Constrained State-Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization: A Discrete and Efficient Heuristic Solver for Precise Harmonic Programming
quick_skim.abstract: Harmonic programmed pulse width modulation (HPPWM), offering flexible harmonic regulation, is a promising solution for high-power energy conversion systems. However, most existing methods solve HPPWM in a continuous space while ignoring the finite timer resolution of practical digital controllers. This leads to a potential optimality deviation during deployment. Motivated by this, this paper proposes a Grid-Constrained State-Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization (GCSA-PSO) strategy. By matching the solution space with practical timer constraints, GCSA-PSO directly searches for implementable pulse sequences in the discrete solution space, thereby improving deployment consistency while reducing the search burden. Moreover, a state-adaptive evaluation strategy is developed to assign different cost evaluations according to particle states, avoiding unnecessary evaluations and improving computational efficiency. Experimental data confirm that, compared with the classical method, the proposed method reduces the computational time while achieving higher control accuracy under practical digital-controller deployment.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper proposes a grid-constrained state-adaptive particle swarm optimization (GCSA-PSO) to directly search implementable pulse sequences in the discrete solution space for harmonic programmed PWM, improving deployment consistency of high-power converters.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对现有谐波编程脉宽调制多在连续解空间求解而忽略数字控制器定时器分辨率、导致实际部署时最优性偏差的问题，本文提出网格约束的自适应状态粒子群优化策略GCSA-PSO，将解空间与实际定时器约束匹配，直接在离散解空间中搜索可实现脉冲序列，从而提升部署一致性并简化求解。该策略为高功率电能变换系统的精确谐波编程提供了一种高效且可直接移植的启发式优化工具，可推广到双有源桥等变换器的效率优化。
